widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic. VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter. [Shot 2] At 00:01.000 hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun. [Shot 3] At 00:02.500 clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once. [Shot 4] At 00:04.000 final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability. Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves. All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

overall_soundscape: Lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise texture present throughout.

non_diegetic_music: VHS tape-noise sample joins at 00:02.500, melody fading for the last second.

nodes.title: 📋 Features & Requirements
widgets_values:
## Requirements

### Required
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF)
- [ComfyUI-DaSiWa-Nodes](https://github.com/darksidewalker/ComfyUI-DaSiWa-Nodes)
- [ffmpeg](https://www.ffmpeg.org/)

---

## Core Features

* 🎬 MiniMax H3 modes: T2VA, I2VA, L2VA, FL2VA, REF2VA and single-frame Image Inpaint in one workflow
* 🖼️ Reference Director: image, video and audio lanes with drag-reorder, per-media prompts and first-frame video thumbnails
* 🎵 Audio references: standalone tracks, external video soundtracks and embedded-video V / A / V+A selection
* ⏱️ Media trimming: draggable crop markers, playable crop preview and validated reference-duration limits
* 📋 Fast media input: file-manager drag-and-drop, lane-selected Ctrl+V and paste-replace on a selected tile
* 📸 RefMods: saved image, video and audio references, including v5 bundles, with strength and editable descriptions
* ✍️ Prompt editor: one free-text prompt per mode with optional structure, shot insertion and reference-label prefill
* ✨ Prompt Forge: draft and review prompts with a local LLM, Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible server; vision models can inspect reference pictures
* ♾️ Continuity: optionally extend a completed H3 video/audio take with a separate next-action prompt
* 📐 Smart resolution: automatic or custom aspect, resolution and megapixel presets with Torch Resize input scaling
* 💾 Reference packs: save and load media, prompts and RefMod selections with append or overwrite
* 🧩 Native H3 generation: Director and Guide route to ComfyUI’s built-in H3 nodes with selected-model lazy loading
* ⚡ Optional performance patches: MiniMax H3 Cache and Comfy Kitchen INT8 attention
* 💎 Optional finishing: RTX denoise, deblur and upscale; watermark overlay; video encoding with audio, preview and first/last-frame PNG exports
* 💧 Watermark overlay - custom branding on final output
* 💾 Advanced automatic video save
* 🖼️ First/last frame extraction
* ➿ Frame interpolation

nodes.title: 🚀 Quick Start Guide
widgets_values:
## 🚀 Quick Start

Ships in **I2VA**. All five MiniMax H3 modes are one click away on the Director pills: **T2VA · I2VA · FL2VA · L2VA · REF2VA**.

**1 · Load models (Settings panel)** — choose UNET (FL2VA / REF2VA), CLIP, Visual VAE and Audio VAE (Audio VAE is required for REF2VA). Files → **Model Links** note.

**2 · Set the canvas (Director)** — the Resolution panel under the mode pills drives output size; all three default **Auto**:
- **Aspect** — *Auto* follows your first visual reference (4:3 with none); or pick a ratio / CUSTOM.
- **Resolution** — *Auto* = 768 px short side; or MP / fixed-res / CUSTOM.
- **Input scaling** — *Auto* preprocesses references (never upscales a source ≤ 2048 px short edge).
Also set **duration** (s) and **frame_rate** (default 24 → feeds 48 fps to the Combine in this workflow).

**3 · Write the prompt (Director builder)** — FL2VA/I2VA/L2VA/T2VA: fill `integrated_multimodal_description`, `overall_soundscape`, `non_diegetic_music` (alignment lines are auto-injected; a blank `non_diegetic_music` becomes `N/A`). REF2VA: six sections (subject_definitions, summary, retention_analysis, detailed_description, overall_soundscape, non_diegetic_music) — use **Prefill Labels & Summary** + **Insert [Shot N]**. The **Simple / Structured** toggle changes how fields assemble; **▶ Preview Prompt** shows the exact final text.

**4 · Add references (REF2VA / images for I2VA·FL2VA)** — add by **+**, drag-drop, or **Ctrl+V** into the Image/Video or Audio lane. Paste over a selected tile to **replace** it in place (keeps its slot). Trim with the crop handles (2–15 s each); **▶ Play crop** previews just the crop; drag the range to scrub. Per-video **V / A / V+A** selects the stream; standalone audio shows a waveform.

**Queue** — **Queue Prompt** (Ctrl+Enter); the Guide node validates everything and routes to the native H3 backend automatically.

Ready-made templates: the example nodes beside this one.

nodes.title: ⚙️ Settings & Post-Processing
widgets_values:
## ⚙️ Settings & Post-Processing

The **Settings** subgraph exposes every critical parameter in one panel. Canvas + prompt live in the **Director** node (see Quick Start).

### Sampling
| Setting | Value here | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Sampler | res_multistep | recommended for MiniMax H3 |
| Scheduler | simple | controls noise removal per step |
| Sampler (Turbo) | euler | recommended for MiniMax H3 |
| Steps | 25 | more = higher quality, slower |
| Steps (Turbo) | 4-8 | more = higher quality, slower |
| Noise Seed | any | randomize or fix for reproducibility |
| Shift Video | 10-12 | video-branch sigma shift |
| Shift Audio | 3-5 | audio-branch sigma shift |
| Shift Video (Turbo) | 6-8 | video-branch sigma shift |
| Shift Audio (Turbo) | 4-5 | audio-branch sigma shift |

### Models
| Setting | File |
|---|---|
| UNET (FL2VA) | minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot |
| UNET (REF2VA) | minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot |
| CLIP | qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int4_convrot |
| Visual VAE | minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16 |
| Audio VAE | minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32 (required for REF2VA) |
| Preview VAE (taeh3) | taeh3.safetensors — fast in-graph preview |

### Acceleration (new companion nodes)
| Toggle | Node | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🔮 ComfyKitchen Attention | Model Attention Backend (native) | ON | Native ComfyUI INT8 attention backend (needs Comfy Kitchen support) |
| 🧺 MiniMax H3 Cache | MiniMax H3 Cache | OFF | block-stack residual cache (reuse 0.05, 15–90%, ≤2 steps); speeds up repeated runs — ⚠️ can ghost/morph |
| ⚙️ Chunking | MiniMax H3 Chunk FeedForward | OFF | Reduces VRAM usage by feeding chunks forward. |

### Output pipeline (toggles)
Each toggle bypasses its whole stage when OFF (no-op):
| Toggle | Stage | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Frame interpolation | RIFE ×2 (rife_v4.26) | OFF |
| Post resize | DaSiWa Torch Resize | OFF |
| Upscale with model | 2x-AnimeSharpV4_RCAN | OFF |
| RTX Upscaler & Refiner | 2× real-time (RTX GPUs only) | OFF |
| Latent Upscaler 2x | Extreme HQ 2x ; Ultra slow | OFF |
| Watermark | DaSiWa Watermark | OFF |

Frame interpolation doubles the frame count; the Director's `frame_rate` is ×2 by a math node and fed to the Combine (→ 48 fps here), so the encoded rate matches the interpolated stream.

### Watermark
Position **bottom-right**, scale 0.12, opacity 0.35, 20 px padding. Upload/replace the PNG from this panel.

---

## 🎬 Video Combine (DaSiWa EnhancedVideoCombine)
| Setting | Value / choices |
|---|---|
| Frame rate | from Director ×2 (48 fps here) |
| Codec | Auto / AV1 / VP9 / H.264 / H.265(HEVC) — hardware-first fallback |
| Container | Auto per codec (WebM/MKV/MP4) |
| Bit depth | Auto (8-bit vs 10-bit) |
| Quality (CRF/CQ) | 30 here (lower = better quality, larger file) |
| Log level | Standard |
| Ping-Pong | OFF |
| Save metadata | ON (embeds prompt/workflow JSON) |
| Save output / pass frames | ON |

widgets_values_named.text:
## ⚙️ Settings & Post-Processing

The **Settings** subgraph exposes every critical parameter in one panel. Canvas + prompt live in the **Director** node (see Quick Start).

### Sampling
| Setting | Value here | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Sampler | res_multistep | recommended for MiniMax H3 |
| Scheduler | simple | controls noise removal per step |
| Sampler (Turbo) | euler | recommended for MiniMax H3 |
| Steps | 25 | more = higher quality, slower |
| Steps (Turbo) | 4-8 | more = higher quality, slower |
| Noise Seed | any | randomize or fix for reproducibility |
| Shift Video | 10-12 | video-branch sigma shift |
| Shift Audio | 3-5 | audio-branch sigma shift |
| Shift Video (Turbo) | 6-8 | video-branch sigma shift |
| Shift Audio (Turbo) | 4-5 | audio-branch sigma shift |

### Models
| Setting | File |
|---|---|
| UNET (FL2VA) | minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot |
| UNET (REF2VA) | minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot |
| CLIP | qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int4_convrot |
| Visual VAE | minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16 |
| Audio VAE | minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32 (required for REF2VA) |
| Preview VAE (taeh3) | taeh3.safetensors — fast in-graph preview |

### Acceleration (new companion nodes)
| Toggle | Node | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🔮 ComfyKitchen Attention | Model Attention Backend (native) | ON | Native ComfyUI INT8 attention backend (needs Comfy Kitchen support) |
| 🧺 MiniMax H3 Cache | MiniMax H3 Cache | OFF | block-stack residual cache (reuse 0.05, 15–90%, ≤2 steps); speeds up repeated runs — ⚠️ can ghost/morph |
| ⚙️ Chunking | MiniMax H3 Chunk FeedForward | OFF | Reduces VRAM usage by feeding chunks forward. |

### Output pipeline (toggles)
Each toggle bypasses its whole stage when OFF (no-op):
| Toggle | Stage | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Frame interpolation | RIFE ×2 (rife_v4.26) | OFF |
| Post resize | DaSiWa Torch Resize | OFF |
| Upscale with model | 2x-AnimeSharpV4_RCAN | OFF |
| RTX Upscaler & Refiner | 2× real-time (RTX GPUs only) | OFF |
| Latent Upscaler 2x | Extreme HQ 2x ; Ultra slow | OFF |
| Watermark | DaSiWa Watermark | OFF |

Frame interpolation doubles the frame count; the Director's `frame_rate` is ×2 by a math node and fed to the Combine (→ 48 fps here), so the encoded rate matches the interpolated stream.

### Watermark
Position **bottom-right**, scale 0.12, opacity 0.35, 20 px padding. Upload/replace the PNG from this panel.

---

## 🎬 Video Combine (DaSiWa EnhancedVideoCombine)
| Setting | Value / choices |
|---|---|
| Frame rate | from Director ×2 (48 fps here) |
| Codec | Auto / AV1 / VP9 / H.264 / H.265(HEVC) — hardware-first fallback |
| Container | Auto per codec (WebM/MKV/MP4) |
| Bit depth | Auto (8-bit vs 10-bit) |
| Quality (CRF/CQ) | 30 here (lower = better quality, larger file) |
| Log level | Standard |
| Ping-Pong | OFF |
| Save metadata | ON (embeds prompt/workflow JSON) |
| Save output / pass frames | ON |
| Filename prefix | video/%date:yyyy-MM-dd%/%date:hhmmss% |
| Crop to audio | OFF |
| Audio codec / bitrate | 192k |
| Save first / last frame | OFF |
